subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should OpenClaw ship on-device Android speech recognition as a built-in chat-composer control rather than leave inline speech-to-text to platform keyboard tooling?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing capability with no existing product contract; correctness and tests cannot establish whether this belongs in the core Android composer.

options.title: Sponsor built-in dictation
options.body: Accept the Android composer feature once recognizer-enabled proof demonstrates transcript insertion and owner-safe behavior.

options.title: Keep platform dictation external
options.body: Decline the core control and rely on the Android keyboard or a later, explicitly scoped speech-input product design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor built-in dictation
recommendation.body: Accept the Android composer feature once recognizer-enabled proof demonstrates transcript insertion and owner-safe behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline assigns this person and the current branch commits show direct involvement in the Android implementation.
